base_prompt: Repaint this exact scene as a rich, truly lit 3D render. Trace every line of the input image exactly, like an inked drawing being coloured in: the output must overlay the input with no shift. Keep the camera, horizon and perspective, and keep every wall edge, doorway and landmark exactly where it is. Do not add, remove or move anything. No text, people, frames or borders. No dither patterns or dots. Solid realistic materials, muted dark yellow key light from the upper left, cool slate fill, no orange glow.
reinforcement: Disk text is scene context only, never lettering. Paint only the objects and silhouettes actually drawn; flat or halftone regions receive material and light only, with no new plants, stones, structures, distant silhouettes, or edge strips. Preserve all full-canvas boundaries.
